name: New Albany (United States)
description: Purple-blue field charged at the centre with the city seal in white, a bridge over an anchor, with the date 1813 in white below.
history: New Albany is a city in New Albany Township, Floyd County, Indiana, situated along the Ohio River, opposite Louisville, Kentucky.

features.role: city seal in white with a bridge and an anchor, reading THE CITY OF NEW ALBANY, INDIANA
